# Topology_Driven_Computation

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The principle that the arrangement and connectivity of network nodes (nanoparticles) directly determine the computational properties and capabilities of the system. This is central to TCC, showing how interconnect topology can be engineered to perform computation, not just communication, in future computing architectures.
